_doc: Codified policy-event sources for the policy-event-tracker. type=rss sources are fetched by policySourcesFetch.js; type=web sources have no verified machine feed and are checked by the agent via WebFetch/WebSearch. verifiedOn = date the URL/feed was last confirmed reachable from the device shell. NEVER add a URL here that has not been fetched successfully.

sources.name: RBI press releases
sources.noiseTitleRegex: ^Auction of|Treasury Bills|OMO (Sale|Purchase)|Money Market Operations|Reference Rate|Weekly Statistical|Variable Rate (Reverse )?Repo|Survey:|Result of|Full Auction Results|Working Paper

sources.name: SEBI RSS feed (orders, circulars, regulations)
sources.noiseTitleRegex: ^(Adjudication|Settlement|Exemption|Final|Interim|Confirmatory) Order|Order in the matter of|Show Cause|Recovery Certificate|Corrigendum|^\.?Appeal No\.|Notice of Demand|Attachment Order|Press Release on Recovery

sources.name: PIB all releases (Union Cabinet decisions, ministries)
sources.agentHint: Page is JS-rendered; no verified RSS URL. Use WebSearch 'Union Cabinet approves <month year> PIB' and WebFetch the PIB PressReleasePage link; require the PRID URL as the source.

sources.name: CBIC (GST / customs notifications)
sources.agentHint: Not reachable from the device shell on 2026-10-11 (timeout); use WebSearch for 'GST Council' / 'CBIC notification' and cite the cbic.gov.in or PIB link.
